title: 3D object in a studio (Three.js)
summary: The product's real things as objects in a lit studio — its screenshot on a floating device, its logo or icon SVG extruded — with one continuous camera: a low swinging reveal, a push into a detail with the focus following, a crane round the whole object, a hero frame with type.
best_for: a premium launch or a hero shot
a logo, an icon or a device as a real object
strong camera moves through a space
